glyph_origin: Pictogram (象形) – a mouse or rat. In the seal script form, which is inherited in the regular script, the upper component resembling 臼 represents the open mouth of a rat with teeth displayed, and the lower component represents the two feet of a rat on the left and a tail on the right.
senses: [shǔ] rat; mouse; any member of the superfamily Muroidea, rodent
[shǔ] Rat (first of the Chinese zodiac signs)
